parameters.name: CustomType
parameters.description:
The type of the baseline check policy. Valid values:

*   **custom**: a custom baseline check policy
*   **common**: a standard baseline check policy

parameters.name: CycleDays
parameters.description:
The new interval of the baseline check. Valid values:

*   **1**: every 2 days
*   **3**: every 4 days
*   **7**: every 8 days
*   **30**: every 31 days

parameters.name: CycleStartTime
parameters.description:
The new time range during which the baseline check starts. Valid values:

*   **0**: The baseline check starts within the time range from 00:00 to 06:00.
*   **6**: The baseline check starts within the time range from 06:00 to 12:00.
*   **12**: The baseline check starts within the time range from 12:00 to 18:00.
*   **18**: The baseline check starts within the time range from 18:00 to 24:00.

>  This parameter is deprecated.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The time when the baseline check based on the baseline check policy ends. Specify the time in the hh:mm:ss format.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: The ID of the baseline check policy.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The new name of the baseline check policy.

parameters.name: RiskCustomParams
parameters.description:
The custom configurations of the baseline. The value of this parameter is in the JSON format and contains the following fields:

*   **typeName**: the name of the baseline.

*   **checkDetails**: the details of the baseline. The value is in the JSON format.

    *   **checkId**: the ID of the check item.

    *   **rules**: the rule configurations. The value is in the JSON format.

        *   **ruleId**: the ID of the rule.

        *   **paramList**: the list of parameters in the rule. The value is in the JSON format.

            *   **paramName**: the name of the parameter.
            *   **value**: the value of the parameter.

parameters.name: RiskSubTypeName
parameters.description: The subtype of the baselines. You can call the [DescribeRiskType](~~DescribeRiskType~~) operation to query the subtypes of baselines.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the request.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The time when the baseline check based on the baseline check policy starts. Specify the time in the hh:mm:ss format.

parameters.name: TargetType
parameters.description:
The method that is used to apply the baseline check policy. Valid values:

*   **groupId**: asset groups
*   **uuid**: assets

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas modify-strategy --source-ip 192.168.X.X --cycle-days 1 --name testStrategy --cycle-start-time 18 --risk-sub-type-name hc_exploit_redis --id 245 --risk-custom-params typeName_:_hc_centos_6_custom_,_checkDetails_:_checkId_:4,_rules_:_ruleId_:_pass_min_days_login_defs.must.cus_,_paramList_:_paramName_:_range_val_,_value_:_7 --custom-type common --target-type groupId --start-time 00:01:00 --end-time 05:00:00 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
